# Security policy

Techline Today is maintained independently by Nafis Afzal. The current release candidate has not been publicly deployed. See [implementation and residual risks](../docs/SECURITY.md) for fetch boundaries, CSP, dependency mitigation and release controls.

Please do not post credentials, private provider responses or exploit details in a public issue. GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled: use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/NafisAfzal/techline-today/security/advisories/new). If that channel is unavailable, contact the owner through the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/NafisAfzal) with a nonsensitive request for a private reporting channel.

Include the affected revision, reproducible steps and impact. Keep test data synthetic and avoid accessing accounts or sources without permission. Ordinary UI/content bugs belong in the issue template after publication.
